beer_description:
10 years of BeerCap Barshop!
A special collaboration for a legendary spot in the Minsk craft beer scene.
Our history with BeerCap goes back to 2016, when our second-ever contract brew - "Contract Killer" APA - first hit their taps. We’ve been close partners ever since, and there’s no better way to celebrate this decade-long journey than with a tribute to where it all began.
The soul of our classic, reborn.
We took the original "Contract Killer" recipe as a base: the same malts, the same hops, and the same specs. But we’ve added a modern twist using innovative Lallemand Aurora yeast.
Meet the reincarnation - now in the style of a Northern APA.
Cheers to 10 years of BeerCap!
